entities.summary: Tibati Madvolomafisha Nkambule was the Queen Mother of Swaziland from 1881 to 1889. She was the aunt of King Mbandzeni and following Mbandzeni's death in 1889, she served as the Queen Regent of Swaziland during the minority of King Bhunu, Mbandzeni's son.
